title: ai/marks/<key>.json
description: The owner's marks on one note. The file's name is the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of the note's absolute path in lower case (UTF-8), then '.json' (see ai-store/marks-file). The app adds, edits and removes marks; the MCP server records on a mark the proposal that answers it or the AI's reply; a background run records itself. Every change takes the file's lock (a folder '<file>.lock', taken over after 10 seconds) and writes the file whole. A mark whose proposal is accepted is removed. When the note is renamed or moved its marks move to the new path's file (merged by id); when it goes to the Recycle Bin the file moves to marks/trashed/.

id.description: Made as proposal ids are (marks carried over from the comments of earlier versions keep their ids).

quote.description: The passage, as it was in the note (see comment-anchors).

prefix.description: Up to 32 UTF-16 code units of the note just before the quote (the page may send up to 100).

suffix.description: Up to 32 UTF-16 code units of the note just after the quote.

text.description: What the owner wants of the AI about it, trimmed; '' when nothing.

run.description: The background run working on it (runs/<id>.json), while it runs.

answer.description: The AI's reply (reply_mark); removed when the owner asks anew.

earlier.description: The exchange so far when the owner asked anew after a reply: the last ten turns, oldest first.
